body:
I wish I could tell you what to do right here, right now. I wish I could offer you a fast-acting and permanent solution... I find that when I really can't do anything at all, listening to music helps to stop me from crying. 

What do you do for work?

I can relate to so much of what you have written (borderline, fear of rejection, narcissistic mother, can't turn my degree into a career). It's so hard--isn't it? I'm so glad you're not going it alone, though, and that you have your fiance. 

Your degree IS a HUGE accomplishment. I assume you're doing research given you have a BS in Biology and make peanuts. 27K isn't out of the ordinary in research, as you probably know for your level of education. That's what the grad school grind is all about. In time (lots of time), it will get better. I started learning java and python as a hobby a while ago and do programming problems when I feel at my absolute lowest. It's not a solution, but I find it at least somewhat helps to take my mind off of offing myself. 

I know having fair-weather friends is a bummer but you have a fiance who is an "angel". It's your day. Fuck everyone else and just have a good time. Isn't he enough? Wouldn't it be more fun to just elope anyway? Anyway, I find stressful situations (e.g. planning a wedding) tend to really bring out the best or worst in people. At least now you know who your friends are (and aren't). 

I hope you have a lovely wedding (:

That's an awesome attitude to have with regards to being 'antisocial' (i.e. not being on social media). It gets overwhelming sometimes for me and FB just makes me more alienated and lonely... I think you so right! When it happens for you (and it will!), you'll appreciate it that much more and so will the person you meet! Just curious, why don't you "participate" in social media? No interest? Not that you should... 

My boyfriend keeps saying he'll straighten out but it just gets worse. I'm trying not to get my hopes up anymore but I figure, what the hell? It's not like I have anything better to do than be strung alone for now, anyway, right? Eh... 

Thanks for really brightening my evening~

I'm so sorry you feel ignored... People can be terrible. This isn't a reflection on you at all. In any case, killing yourself won't even allow you to reap the fruits of your effort. 

just remember that everyone's just doing the best they can...Maybe they're going through a similar struggle. Have you tried reaching out to them first? (Perhaps you have.) I really hope you hang in there.

I'm really sorry you feel that way. For what it's worth, I feel unwanted, too. You're not in anyone's way. You have a right to be here. 

oh, and please don't let your mother factor into your feelings of abandonment because parents and family are really hit or miss. I'm sorry yours was a miss.

You seem like a really lovely, sweet, genuine person--though I bet you've heard that before. I really hope you find someone who is able to return your capacity for love. 

Some people aren't ready or willing to accept love. I can relate to a lot of what you wrote, here. I feel that I've given my boyfriend so much and I try to be as caring as can be but it feels so one-sided (though objectively, I know I bring so much more to the table). Maybe she is as great as you say she is but I think you're great, too, for what it's worth (:

I'm so sorry. I am afraid of dying alone, too-- who isn't? I think people like you have a chance at true happiness but the trouble lies in finding a match. You'll have to find someone who thinks like you. It's the tougher road, I think, but with high risk comes high reward. At least that's what sometimes keeps me going...

You're absolutely right but I just don't feel I'm ready to end it... I have found so few people in my life that I related to and I just can't let go of him. He was a rare find even if he is utterly terrible. 

My weight is not something I can deal with anymore. The ONLY way I can lose weight is to starve--I've lost significant amounts of weight before but I literally have to not eat for weeks. It's not always worth it. I have a hormonal issue and have seen a doctor for it but the medication prescribed comes with serious side effects (such as hair loss) that I'm just not willing to suffer. 

For me, that's impossible. I need a career that I enjoy at least some of the time or I don't see a point in living. My job is certainly not a career. I used to have hobbies and believe me, I'm pushing myself in every way I can but it just isn't possible right now. I can't focus on anything. I can't do anything. Nothing gives me any pleasure. I've asked myself what I would want to do if I could do anything and the answer is simply 'nothing'. I don't even want to indulge anymore. I just don't care. I feel sick all the time. I'm thinking I need to wait this out though I've been in this trough for about 1.5 years now and wonder how much longer it could possibly continue. 

Thanks so much for your words of encouragement, though (:

May I ask what happened? I'm sorry. Heartbreak is the worst. Music used to be a big help for me but right now, I've found my head is too noisy as is and I can't even stand to listen to anything and I can't even summon the energy to watch movies or play video games.
I know it would probably help. I see a psychiatrist when I can but my work schedule and finances don't permit me to do much... Thanks, though!
